note: Full sweep of node IDs 1-12000 against SolarQuery /pub, classifying each of: data (public, reporting), silent (public, never reported), private (HTTP 403, node exists but is not publicly readable), absent (no such ID). Rate-limit responses were retried with backoff rather than counted as absent - an earlier scan conflated 403 and 429 with "no node" and undercounted by roughly 4x. `live` means data seen on or after 2026-08-01. No public node IDs were found above 1118.
